story:
Every love story has a beginning, and ours started with a simple friend request on social media.

On June 15, 2025, Adrian added Kate on Facebook, not knowing that she was also a fellow Boholana. They became Facebook friends, but for two months, nothing happened. Life simply went on.

Then, on August 19, 2025, Adrian finally found the courage to send the first message:

"Hi. I just wanna ask... curious lang ko hehe. Nag-work ka karon sa Saudi?"

It was a simple question, but it became the start of something extraordinary.

What began as a casual conversation quickly turned into daily chats, shared laughter, endless stories, and a growing connection. Before they knew it, two strangers had become best friends, partners, and each other's greatest blessing.

Sometimes, the most beautiful love stories don't begin with grand gestures—they begin with one simple message. And from that message, Adrian and Kate found a love that continues to grow stronger every single day.
